question: In right triangle \(ABC\), \(\angle C=90^\circ\), \(AD\) bisects \(\angle BAC\) and meets \(BC\) at \(D\), \(DE\perp AB\) at \(E\), \(BC=12\), and \(BD=7\). Find the length of \(DE\).
solution: \(CD=BC-BD=5\). Since \(D\) lies on the bisector of \(\angle BAC\), \(DC\perp AC\), and \(DE\perp AB\), we have \(DE=DC=5\).
